output.sql:
SELECT p.product_name, ROUND(SUM(ol.net_amount - ol.cogs), 2) AS gross_margin
FROM marts.fct_order_lines ol
JOIN marts.fct_orders o ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
JOIN marts.dim_products p ON p.product_id = ol.product_id
WHERE o.is_revenue = true
  AND o.order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name
ORDER BY gross_margin DESC
LIMIT 3;
output.explanation:
This query returns the three products with the highest gross margin in 2025, along with each product's name and margin.

For each product, gross margin is the line-level net amount minus cost of goods sold, added up across 2025. Only orders flagged as revenue are counted (`is_revenue = true`), and an order falls in 2025 based on its order date. Margins are rounded to 2 decimals and sorted from highest to lowest.

The schema has no currency column, so I've assumed all amounts are already in EUR. No currency conversion is applied.
